# @arki/fs

> File storage for arki apps: S3, R2 and local adapters, and the files table, a Postgres or SQLite upload recipe where the row exists before any byte and nothing is ready until the server saw the object.

## Import paths

<!-- llms:start -->
- `@arki/fs/env`: `env`.
- `@arki/fs/local/delete`: Pass-through of the `del` package. `deleteAsync`, `deleteSync`; types `Options`, `ProgressData`.
- `@arki/fs/local/dir`: `getParentDirName`.
- `@arki/fs/local/glob`: Pass-through of the `glob` package. `glob`, `globIterate`, `globStream`.
- `@arki/fs/local/read-file`: Reads a whole file synchronously and decodes it. `readFile`.
- `@arki/fs/local/read-first-line`: The first line, or undefined for an empty file. `readFirstLine`.
- `@arki/fs/local/write`: Pass-through of Node `appendFile`. `writeToTheFileEnd`.
- `@arki/fs/s3`: `initializeStorage`.
- `@arki/fs/storage`: Storage - Factory. `FILE_READ_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_READ_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_WRITE_FAILURES`, `StorageCancelled`, `StorageNotFound`, `StorageRejected`, `StorageUnavailable`, `StorageWriteUncertain`, `createLocalStorageAdapter`, `createR2Storage`, `createS3StorageAdapter`, `createStorage`; and 13 more.
- `@arki/fs/storage/index`: Storage - Factory. `FILE_READ_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_READ_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_WRITE_FAILURES`, `StorageCancelled`, `StorageNotFound`, `StorageRejected`, `StorageUnavailable`, `StorageWriteUncertain`, `createLocalStorageAdapter`, `createR2Storage`, `createS3StorageAdapter`, `createStorage`; and 13 more.
- `@arki/fs/storage/local-adapter`: `LocalStorageAdapter`, `createLocalStorageAdapter`.
- `@arki/fs/storage/r2`: Storage - Cloudflare R2 Preset. `createR2Storage`; types `R2StorageConfig`.
- `@arki/fs/storage/s3-adapter`: `S3StorageAdapter`, `createS3StorageAdapter`.
- `@arki/fs/storage/types`: types `LocalStorageConfig`, `S3StorageConfig`, `SignedUploadAdapter`, `SignedUrlOptions`, `StorageAdapter`, `StorageCallOptions`, `StorageConfig`, `StorageReadFailure`, `StorageWriteFailure`, `StoreOptions`, `StoredFile`, `StoredFileMetadata`.
- `@arki/fs/files`: the portable half of the files table. `CONFIRM_UPLOAD_FAILURES`, `CREATE_UPLOAD_FAILURES`, `FILE_ERROR_CODES`, `FILE_READ_FAILURES`, `FILE_URL_FAILURES`, `FileStorageError`, `FileUnavailable`, `FileWrongState`, `REMOVE_FILE_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_READ_FAILURES`, `STORAGE_WRITE_FAILURES`, `StorageCancelled`; and 25 more.
- `@arki/fs/orpc`: the files table over oRPC, contract-first. `filesContract`, `filesRouter`, `filesUploadClient`; types `FilesContract`.
- `@arki/fs/pg`: the files table on Postgres. `fileStorage`, `filesTable`, `toFileRecord`; types `CleanupOptions`, `CleanupResult`, `FilePolicy`, `FileRow`, `FileStorage`, `FileStorageOptions`, `FilesDb`, `FilesTable`, `FilesTableOptions`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/fs/sqlite`: the files table on SQLite (libSQL). `fileStorage`, `filesTable`, `toFileRecord`; types `CleanupOptions`, `CleanupResult`, `FilePolicy`, `FileRow`, `FileStorage`, `FileStorageOptions`, `FilesDb`, `FilesTable`, `FilesTableOptions`; and 1 more.
- `@arki/fs/testing`: `memoryUploadAdapter`; types `MemoryUploadAdapter`.
<!-- llms:end -->

## Start here
- [Agent guide](docs/agent-guide.md): read first.
- [README](README.md): the long overview and peers per entry.

## By task
- Upload from a browser: `uploadFile` (`@arki/fs/files`) against `filesContract` and `filesRouter` (`@arki/fs/orpc`).
- Store file rows: `filesTable` and `fileStorage` from `@arki/fs/pg`, or `@arki/fs/sqlite` (libSQL).
- Pick a bucket: `createS3StorageAdapter`, `createR2Storage`, `createLocalStorageAdapter` from `@arki/fs/storage`.
- Test uploads: `memoryUploadAdapter`, `browserPut` from `@arki/fs/testing`.

## Rules that bite
- The five calls are `createUpload`, `confirmUpload`, `url`, `remove` and `cleanupOrphans`. Each takes the acting owner id first.
- Failures are returned, never thrown: `FileUnavailable`, `UploadPending`, `FileWrongState`, `UploadMismatch`. Check with `isFailure`.
- Never mark a file ready from client success. `confirmUpload` checks size and type against the stored object.
- Store the `FileId`, never the URL. Every URL expires.
- Pass the root Drizzle db, never a transaction. Never do storage I/O inside a DB transaction.
- The local adapter cannot sign uploads. Use MinIO or a dev R2 bucket.
- Thrown faults carry `FileStorageError.code`: `ARKI_FS_E001`, `E006`, `E007`.
